about: Before the Gospel of the Mass, the priest asks for the Lord’s blessing when celebrating without a deacon or subdeacon. This prayer follows Munda cor meum and is omitted in Masses for the dead.

ex.w001: The priest asks the Lord for a blessing for himself, not for a congregation.

seg.tr: May the Lord be in my heart and on my lips, so that I may proclaim His Gospel worthily and fittingly.

a.g: I may worthily and fittingly proclaim

ex.w019: The Gospel belongs to the Lord, not to the priest who proclaims it.
